newFindings.title: An attempt that calls a model can no longer settle a terminal result
newFindings.detail: The prefixed digest now lands in factory_execution_operations.provider_receipt_digest on both the completed and uncertain paths. verifyRunnerResultInTransaction imposes two conditions that cannot both be met: executions.ts:361 calls validateFactoryRunnerResult, whose validateOperation requires validDigest(providerReceiptDigest, false) i.e. BARE 64-hex (factory-sdk/src/validation.ts:626); and executions.ts:368 requires the result to MIRROR the journal row, prefix included.
newFindings.proof: /tmp/w01e-terminal-probe.ts against PGlite with the real journal: 'MIRRORED result: REJECTED — Factory terminal result is invalid: RUNNER_OPERATION.' and 'STRIPPED result: REJECTED — Factory terminal result does not match settled journal evidence.'
newFindings.forced: The leaf's choice is forced, not careless: FactoryUsageReconciliation.resolve reads the raw journal row and enforces the prefix at usage-settlement.ts:410, so the row must be prefixed for W03c to work at all.
newFindings.disclosure: The worker disclosed the disagreement in the freeze line and a gate-file section, but framed it as 'a pre-existing disagreement on W03's own two surfaces' without stating this consequence.
newFindings.ownership: Neither surface belongs to W01: factory-sdk/src/validation.ts is Sol controls', usage-settlement.ts is W03's (interface freeze section 12).
newFindings.fix: Coordinator ruling to unify the operation receipt digest shape on one surface, then make the guest model path match.

newFindings.title: The named readiness failure factory-postgres-store-down is false; the store is up
newFindings.detail: The gate file leaves G5 unchecked and asks the coordinator to recreate the store. The container runs under podman, not docker, so the worker's `docker ps -a` check could not list it.
newFindings.impact: G5 is marked open when it passes, and the gate file requests recreation of a healthy shared store that seven other agents were queued against, which common.md forbids anyone but the coordinator from doing and which previously caused an OOM kill.
newFindings.fix: Check G5 with the receipt and delete the readiness-failure paragraph.
